verdict.rationale: Letta's MemFS docs say keyword search and optional semantic or hybrid search are available, but only by installing the separate MemFS Search mod. So developers can move beyond a single fixed similarity search, but only through an add-on that is documented in a single line. missing for 10: metadata filtering of retrieval, reranking support, detail on configuring search modes in the core product, independent or hands-on corroboration.
